label: mcl_core_log_big_oak_top
reference_prompt: Create a close visual reference for the cut end-grain of an ancient dark oak trunk in a grounded dark-fantasy world. The cross-section should reveal centuries of slow, stressed growth: numerous tight irregular rings, broad dark heartwood, narrower weathered sapwood, old internal scars and restrained radial checking. Tannin-rich wood creates deep brown and cool umber zones without becoming nearly black. Avoid a perfect circular target, decorative spiral grain, giant splits, polished furniture wood or supernatural markings. The material should feel dense enough that cutting it was difficult. Let the end-grain tell the tree's age through compressed growth history and heavy heartwood. This is an authored material reference only; the source texture will determine final geometry.
